# BlackSilk Bulletproofs+ vectors (docs/transactions.md §1.3, §7). Test data,
# read by crypto/tests/bpp_vectors.rs. One `name = value` per line; hex unless
# noted.
#
# gen.*        generators G, H, Gbp[i], Hbp[i]; gen.digest is the untagged
#              Blake2b-256 of Gbp[0..1024] || Hbp[0..1024] (compressed points).
#              Consensus; independently re-derived by the test.
# accept.k<k>  consensus accept vectors for k commitments: V (concatenated
#              commitments), proof (A || A1 || B || r1 || s1 || d1 || L[..] ||
#              R[..]), proof_len (decimal bytes), and the transcript values t0,
#              y, z, e_rounds (concatenated round challenges) and e, which the
#              test re-derives from the proof bytes with the spec formulas.
#              Statement: amounts and masks are listed in the test (amounts());
#              masks are from_bytes_mod_order_wide([0x70 + j; 64]).
# prover.k<k>  REGRESSION PINS of the prover (bulletproofs_plus::prove with
#              ChaCha20Rng::seed_from_u64(0xb000 + k)). Wallet-side, not
#              consensus: a legitimate prover change updates only these lines.
#              At pinning time they equal accept.k<k>.proof.
#
# Reject vectors are single changes of accept.k2 and accept.k3, defined in the
# test source (reject_vectors).
